填任何 OpenAI 兼容平台的地址（到 /v1 为止）和 Key，模型列表、能: Fill in the endpoint (up to /v1) and key of any OpenAI-compatible platform; the model list and image support are read from the platform. API runs on Claude Code, so Claude Code must be installed, but you don't need to sign in to a Claude account.
内容会经过该平台，平台可能记录提问。Key 只存在这台电脑上。: Your messages go through that platform, which may log prompts. The key is stored only on this computer.

还没填接口地址：填好再点保存。: No endpoint yet. Fill it in and save again.
先填接口地址（到 /v1 为止），再填 Key: Fill in the endpoint first (up to /v1), then the key

{names} 的模型平台没说明能不能看图，先按看不了处理：它们只会收到图片的文: The platform doesn't say whether {names}' models can see images, so they're treated as text-only: they will only receive the image file paths.
